negative_snippets:
We had a pleasant stay overall. I must specifically commend the Front Office team for their excellent hospitality; the check-in process was smooth, and the staff was incredibly welcoming and helpful throughout our visit. It is also a very kids-friendly property, and my children really enjoyed their time here.
However, to make this a true 5-star experience, a few updates are needed. The breakfast menu felt a bit limited and could use more variety. Additionally, the in-room amenities (such as toiletries and coffee/tea supplies) were quite basic and could be improved to match the quality of the service. We would love to visit again and see these improvements!
